scenario: Instruction budget, the Pro stack search's worst case (audit round 3): 18 product rules that all combine with each other, every one of the 200 lines listing a DIFFERENT 12 of them; the stack is searched among a line's 6 best-ranked candidates only (plan.ts MAX_STACK_CANDIDATES), so each line stacks its 6 best. A cost price on every line, a 5 % order discount, 1–2 variant-level refs of other variants a line: the input filled to Shopify's limit of 128 kB of MessagePack. The exact output is over the budget: every stack goes to its top rule. With the ids the checkout sends: within 90 % of Shopify's (line-scaled) limit.
